title: Personal Branding
subtitle: My Khmer name, ម៉ាត់រ៉ភីយ៉ះ, drawn as a personal seal.
teaser: A small family of marks built from my name in Khmer, shown at their proper sizes with the palette and the rules that keep them consistent.

name.khmer: ម៉ាត់រ៉ភីយ៉ះ

story: ម៉ាត់រ៉ភីយ៉ះ is my name written in Khmer. Instead of a typed logo, it is drawn as a personal seal. The letterforms are set by hand and preserved as fixed outlines, so the identity never re-renders in a live font.

The seal appears as a small family: the bare calligraphy, the same letters reversed out of a rounded tile, an enclosing frame, and a circular composition. It uses flat colour only, in ink, paper, and a single seal vermilion, so it reads the same on a browser tab, an avatar, or this page.

marks.name: Open seal
marks.description: The given-name calligraphy without an enclosing field.

marks.name: Rounded seal
marks.description: The calligraphy reversed out of a filled rounded square.
marks.use: Square avatar. Its vermilion version is the browser favicon.

marks.name: Framed seal
marks.description: The calligraphy enclosed by its separate frame.

marks.name: Circle
marks.description: A circular composition with the lettering on a filled disc.

navMarks.name: Compact signature
navMarks.description: Equal-height seal and bilingual name, split by a divider.

navMarks.name: Navigation seal
navMarks.description: The seal on its own, tuned for small sizes.
navMarks.use: Seal-only home link where space is tight.

palette.name: Ink
palette.use: Marks and text on light grounds.

palette.name: Vermilion
palette.use: The seal red, used for the favicon ground and accents.

palette.name: Paper
palette.use: The warm off-white ground. Marks reverse to paper on dark.

usage: One flat colour per mark: ink on light, paper on dark, or vermilion on paper. Never vermilion on ink.
Show the whole mark. Never crop, stretch, rotate, or recolour a part of it.
Give it room, with clear space of at least one eighth of its size on every side.
Keep to the minimum sizes. Below them, the Khmer diacritics stop resolving.
